main.number: skip: sanction serial number (identifier); used only as a sort key
main.companyname: chart-companies, insight:repeat, insight:private — display name of each corporation (its most frequent spelling); private executors are aggregated, never named
main.hpnumber: chart-companies, chart-repeat, chart-entity, kpi:corps, insight:repeat, insight:private, insight:double — corporate key (9 digits starting with 5)
main.adress: skip: free-text construction-site address (project, block and parcel), no separate city field; not reliably aggregable, and the explorer searches it
main.date: chart-yearly, chart-heat, chart-theme-year, chart-tariff, chart-entity, chart-objections, kpi:count, kpi:settled, insight:trend
main.volationclause: chart-themes, chart-theme-year, insight:theme — normalised into violation themes by regex
main.sum: chart-yearly, chart-themes, chart-tariff, chart-companies, kpi:total, kpi:typical, kpi:final, insight:tariff, insight:double
main.decisiondate: skip: mixed date formats (four styles) and often earlier than the sanction date; not reliable for timing
main.commissionersdecision: chart-objections, chart-reduction, kpi:final, insight:objections — free text normalised to rejection / reduction / cancellation
main.reductionpercentage: chart-reduction, insight:reduction — fallback when amounts are missing; the actual cut is computed from the amounts because this column has typos
main.committeepercentage: skip: 4 non-empty values; the committee's amount is taken from sumaftercommittee
